data.description:
## Description

**What**: Add `dso.workflow=local|ci-pr` as the canonical single config key to `read-config.sh`, with a backward-compatible shim that maps the four legacy keys (`merge.strategy`, `enforcement.strategy`, `worktree.isolation_enabled`, `attribution.enabled`) to `dso.workflow` at read time.

**Why**: This is the foundation story — every other story in the epic depends on `read-config.sh` being able to produce `dso.workflow` from both legacy and new configs. Without this shim, the migrator, hot-path scripts, and onboarding changes cannot be implemented.

**Scope**:
- IN: `read-config.sh` compat shim; deprecation warning (once per process, suppressible via DSO_DEPRECATION_QUIET=1); contradictory-config detection + fallback to `local`; missing-config non-zero exit directing to `/dso:onboarding`; shell fixture tests for all four SC2 cases
- OUT: The migrator script (S2), post-sentinel lockout (S3), onboarding write path (S4), hot-path script updates (S5)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `read-config.sh dso.workflow` against a legacy-only config returns the shim-derived value with a one-time stderr deprecation warning naming each legacy key (suppressible via DSO_DEPRECATION_QUIET=1, which `validate.sh --ci` sets automatically)
  ← Satisfies: SC2(a) legacy keys only → shim-derived value with deprecation warning
- When this story is complete, `read-config.sh dso.workflow` against a config containing only `dso.workflow=<value>` returns the canonical value with no warning
  ← Satisfies: SC2(b) dso.workflow only → canonical value, no warning
- When this story is complete, `read-config.sh dso.workflow` against a contradictory legacy config (`merge.strategy=pr` + `enforcement.strategy=local`, or `merge.strategy=direct` + `enforcement.strategy=ci`) emits a stderr warning naming the conflicting keys and returns `local`
  ← Satisfies: SC2(c) contradictory legacy config → warning + fallback to local
- When this story is complete, `read-config.sh dso.workflow` when no `dso-config.conf` exists exits non-zero with a stderr message directing the user to run `/dso:onboarding`
  ← Satisfies: SC2(d) no dso-config.conf → non-zero exit with direction to /dso:onboarding
- When this story is complete, unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic in `read-config.sh`

## Considerations

- [Testing] Shell test suite must cover all four fixture configs (a-d) with assertable exit codes and stderr output
- [Reliability] Deprecation warning must be emitted once per process invocation, not once per read call (to avoid log spam in scripts that call read-config.sh multiple times)

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO skill consumer, read-config.sh recognizes dso.workflow as the canonical config key with a backward-compatible shim
